title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.

With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

The main idea of this role is to protect the institution's ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil's context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)

Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Apaixonado por moda e esportes? Então esta é sua chance! Aqui, você vai deixar nossas lojas sempre estilosas e irresistíveis, garantindo que cada vitrine e ambiente mostre as últimas tendências.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo

  • Boa comunicação e facilidade no aprendizado

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

As a UX Designer, you will be focused on designing and evolving digital products that optimize kitchen operations, inventory management, and location handling for multiple stakeholders. description:

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide.   • Possess excellent cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills, able to effectively drive different teams to solve problems collaboratively, and have strong project execution capabilities and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Have empathy for the rider community, be able to think from the rider's perspective, understand the actual needs and pain points of riders in delivery fulfillment, and possess strong problem-solving skills and innovative awareness.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the rapid global expansion of Meituan's delivery business and experience accelerated professional growth.

Comercial

Pré-vendas

Em que você poderá:

  • Colaborar na elaboração de propostas técnicas, gerar prices e participar de reuniões internas com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar um projeto exclusivo para o Programa Potenciais, que envolve tecnologia aplicada à área de Pré-Vendas.

Nesse processo você contará com um time altamente qualificado de gerentes e diretores para capacitá-lo durante sua jornada.

Nosso time de Gente & Cultura estará a postos para desenvolver habilidades e garantir o melhor aproveitamento do programa!

Além de diversos treinamentos e ferramentas que farão com que você se torne protagonista da sua carreira!

Requisitos e qualificações

Quais são os requisitos?

Estar cursando ensino superior;

Ter disponível pelo menos 1 ano e 6 meses para estagiar (se formar a partir de junho/2027);

Ter disponibilidade de estagiar 6 horas por dia em horário comercial;

Ter interesse de atuar nas áreas destacadas no programa (Comercial e pré-vendas), afinal este é o foco do Programa Potenciais;

Ser curioso e ter vontade de aprender todos os dias;

Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente de 3 a 4 vezes por semana em um dos nosso escritórios em São Paulo (São Paulo-SP e Jaguariúna-SP);

Todos os requisitos são obrigatórios! Preencha seu formulário de inscrição com muita atenção, ok!

Inglês avançado é um diferencial, temos clientes globais!

Não nos apegamos a curso ou instituição! O que nós queremos saber é se você topa esse desafio com a gente.

Bolsa Auxílio - compatível com o mercado

Academia Stefanini - Uma plataforma repleta de conteúdo, cursos e treinamentos.

️Assistência psicológica.

E muito mais!

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We're poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we're working with the world's largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We're looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos / Human Resources Analyst
description:
G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais ao setor de mineração, atuando em projetos subterrâneos e a céu aberto com metais preciosos, básicos e industriais. Reconhecida como uma das principais consultorias em engenharia de minas do Canadá e entre as mais renomadas em projetos internacionais, a G Mining está expandindo e consolidando sua presença no Brasil. Após o sucesso do projeto da Mina de Tocantinzinho, a empresa está abrindo um novo escritório no país para colaborar com talentos locais em futuros projetos no Brasil e no exterior.

Como empresa familiar, a G Mining valoriza seus colaboradores, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal por meio de oportunidades únicas de carreira, incentivo à colaboração e um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, seguro e inclusivo.

Analista de Recursos Humanos

Resumo da Posição

O(a) profissional atuará como Analista de Recursos Humanos, apoiando a operação local e contribuindo para a consolidação da estrutura organizacional da empresa no Brasil. Será responsável por garantir a execução eficiente das rotinas de RH e por fortalecer a cultura corporativa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ético e alinhado aos valores globais da G Mining Services.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar todo o ciclo de recrutamento e seleção, desde a divulgação das vagas até o onboarding.
  • Manter e atualizar registros e contratos de colaboradores (CLT e prestadores de serviço).
  • Apoiar nas rotinas de folha de pagamento, controle de ponto, férias, benefícios e rescisões.
  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (saúde, odontológico, alimentação, transporte e seguro de vida), incluindo controles mensais, inclusões e exclusões.
  • Apoiar nas relações trabalhistas e garantir conformidade com a legislação brasileira (CLT).
  • Apoiar na organização e execução de ações de integração, treinamentos e iniciativas de engajamento.
  • Contribuir com ideias e auxiliar na implementação de programas de bem-estar e cultura que fortaleçam a experiência do colaborador.
  • Preparar relatórios e indicadores de RH (headcount, benefícios, custos de pessoal etc.) para suporte à gestão.
  • Colaborar com as equipes globais de RH e Administração, mantendo uma comunicação eficaz em inglês.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas generalistas de RH.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e práticas administrativas de RH.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado, para comunicação frequente com equipes internacionais.
  • Boa habilidade com Excel e ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

Perfil desejado

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e atitude colaborativa.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Empatia, integridade e genuíno interesse por pessoas.
  • Flexibilidade e perfil "mão na massa".

Informações Adicionais

A posição será baseada no escritório da G Mining Services em Belo Horizonte, Brasil. A empresa busca profissionais dinâmicos e motivados que desejam integrar uma equipe experiente e comprometida com o sucesso de seus projetos.

Benefícios

  • Bônus por desempenho individual e corporativo.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para colaboradores e familiares.
  • Reembolso de atividades esportivas.
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atividades sociais e de integração.

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

G Mining Services is a multidisciplinary company that provides professional services to the mining sector, working on both open-pit and underground projects involving precious, base, and industrial metals. Recognized as one of Canada's leading mining engineering consultancies and among the most respected in international projects, G Mining is expanding and strengthening its presence in Brazil.

Following the success of the Tocantinzinho Mine project, the company is opening a new office in the country to collaborate with local talent on future projects in Brazil and abroad.

As a family-owned company, G Mining values its employees by promoting both professional and personal development through unique career opportunities, collaboration, and a welcoming, safe, and inclusive work environment.

Human Resources Analyst

Position Summary

The professional will serve as a Human Resources Analyst, supporting local operations and contributing to the consolidation of the company's organizational structure in Brazil. They will be responsible for ensuring the efficient execution of HR routines and for strengthening the corporate culture, fostering a collaborative, ethical, and value-driven work environment aligned with G Mining Services' global standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the entire recruitment and selection cycle, from job posting to onboarding.
  • Maintain and update employee records and contracts (CLT and service providers).
  • Assist with payroll, time tracking, vacation, benefits, and termination processes.
  • Administer corporate benefits (health, dental, meal, transportation, and life insurance), including monthly controls, enrollments, and removals.
  • Support labor relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT).
  • Organize and execute integration, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas and assist in implementing wellness and culture programs that enhance the employee experience.
  • Prepare HR reports and metrics (headcount, benefits, personnel costs, etc.) to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with global HR and Administration teams, maintaining effective communication in English.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in generalist HR routines.
  • Solid knowledge of labor legislation (CLT) and HR administrative practices.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level for frequent communication with international teams.
  • Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office tools.

Desired Profile

  • Organization and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, integrity, and genuine interest in people.
  • Flexibility and hands-on mindset.

Additional Information

The position will be based at G Mining Services' office in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The company seeks dynamic and motivated professionals who wish to join an experienced team committed to project success.

Benefits

  • Individual and corporate performance bonuses.
  • Health and dental plans for employees and their families.
  • Reimbursement for sports activities.
  • Training and professional development programs.
  • Social and integration activities.

title: SAP Release Manager
description:
Role: SAP Release Manager

Location: LATAM Region (Remote)

Duration: 06+ Months Contract

An SAP Release Manager plans, coordinates, and controls the entire SAP release lifecycle, from defining release strategies and schedules to managing deployments and post-go-live support, ensuring quality, minimizing business disruption, and maintaining compliance with standards like ITIL and SOX. Key responsibilities include stakeholder communication, risk management, process governance, and continuous improvement of the release process through post-release reviews and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Planning: Develop and maintain the SAP release strategy, plan, and calendar, coordinating release windows and cycles across various SAP modules and integrated applications.
  • Execution & Coordination: Manage and coordinate all release activities, ensuring timely and seamless execution by working closely with development, testing, and infrastructure teams.
  • Governance & Compliance: Implement and enforce release management processes and quality gates, ensuring adherence to standards such as ITIL, SOX, and audit requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks to the release schedule, quality, and scope, and develop mitigation strategies to prevent delays or disruptions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Liaise with business stakeholders, project managers, and other relevant teams to align release activities with business priorities.
  • Communication: Act as the central point of communication, providing transparency on release plans, risks, impacts, and progress to all involved parties.
  • Post-Release Activities: Conduct post-release reviews and postmortems, track release KPIs (success rate, defect leakage), and identify lessons learned for continuous process improvement.
  • Quality Assurance: Oversee the entire release lifecycle, ensuring that all release criteria, including functionality, performance, and security requirements, are met before deployment.
  • Process Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve workflows and efficiency, developing and implementing automation tools and frameworks to streamline release processes.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior
description:
A aquarela procura um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior para criar e manter soluções de servidor escaláveis e eficientes. Atuando principalmente com Node.js/TypeScript (frameworks Fastify, NestJS) e Python (frameworks Flask, Django), você será responsável por arquitetar APIs robustas e serviços backend que dão suporte a projetos inovadores de IA e Analytics, sempre prezando pela qualidade do código e performance em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de sistemas backend web, com profundo entendimento de arquitetura de servidores, APIs e integrações
  • Domínio de Node.js com TypeScript, incluindo experiência prática com frameworks como Fastify e NestJS
  • Proficiência em Python, com experiência em frameworks web como Flask e Django, para criação de APIs e serviços de dados
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, habilidade em modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas escaláveis (microsserviços, design de APIs RESTful e event-driven; conhecimento de GraphQL é um plus)
  • Familiaridade com padrões de design de software, práticas de segurança (autenticação, autorização, OAuth) e observabilidade (logs, monitoramento) no contexto backend
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações técnicas, artigos e interação ocasional com times ou clientes no exterior
Responsabilidades:
  • Projetar e desenvolver APIs e serviços backend robustos, seguros e escaláveis, garantindo baixa latência e alta disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Definir arquiteturas de sistema adequadas (monolito modular, microsserviços ou serverless), escolhendo tecnologias e designs que melhor atendam aos requisitos de negócio
  • Garantir a qualidade do código backend através de boas práticas de engenharia: escrever código limpo e bem documentado, criar testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) e conduzir revisões de código regulares
  • Otimizar desempenho de aplicações e serviços, analisando e melhorando o uso de recursos (CPU, memória), tempo de resposta de APIs e eficiência de consultas ao banco de dados
  • Colaborar estreitamente com desenvolvedores front-end, engenheiros de dados e demais equipes para integrar sistemas, resolver dependências e solucionar desafios técnicos complexos de forma conjunta
  • Mentorar e liderar tecnicamente membros mais juniores do time de backend, sendo uma referência em boas práticas, arquitetura e resolução de problemas, além de contribuir para a evolução contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência prática com DevOps – habilidade em configurar pipelines de CI/CD, automação de deploy e monitoramento (ex: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) para deploy de serviços, gerenciamento de containers e uso de serviços gerenciados
  • Familiaridade com containerização e orquestração de containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e ferramentas de deploy como Coolify
  • Vivência em implementação de boas práticas de segurança em backend (como proteção de APIs, criptografia de dados sensíveis, gestão de certificados)
  • Experiência com processamento de grande volume de dados, analytics ou machine learning (diferencial que alinha com os projetos de IA da aquarela)
  • Cultura organizacional baseada em inovação, colaboração e respeito mútuo – profissionais que compartilham desses valores e demonstram paixão por resolver problemas complexos se destacarão no nosso time
Modelo de trabalho:
  • Local de trabalho: modelo híbrido para profissionais em Salvador/BA ou Florianópolis/SC; trabalho remoto para candidatos de outras regiões do Brasil
  • Regime de contratação: opção de PJ ou CLT, conforme preferência do profissional
  • Benefícios: pacote de benefícios negociável de acordo com a preferência e necessidade do candidato
  • Remuneração: em aberto, compatível com o mercado e negociável conforme a senioridade/experiência (valorizamos e recompensamos talento de nível sênior)
  • Ferramentas de trabalho: fornecemos os recursos necessários para atuação (equipamentos, acessos) e apoio para cursos/certificações que agreguem ao papel, conforme política interna
Como se candidatar:

Envie seu currículo e, se desejar, link do GitHub/LinkedIn ou portfólio de projetos para , com o assunto "Vaga Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior - (Seu Nome)". Ficaremos felizes em conhecer sua trajetória e como pode somar ao time da aquarela!

title: Calling and Lead Generation Specialist for Commercial Real Estate
description:
Location: Remote

Contract: Independent Contractor

Job Type: Full-Time, Monday-Friday, EST

Salary: Competitive base

Summary:

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Calling and Lead Generation Specialist for Commercial Real Estate to join our growing team. The role requires someone who is both skilled at online research and comfortable making a high volume of phone calls every day. You will be responsible for sourcing information on and engaging potential capital providers for our commercial real estate debt and equity brokerage firm, with a focus on the U.S. market. This includes conducting targeted research across multiple channels to uncover lender and investor criteria and then reaching out by phone to qualify their interest in active opportunities. The ideal candidate is organized, persistent, and adept at gathering and analyzing information online while confidently engaging prospects over the phone. This position offers the chance to develop expertise in real estate capital markets while making a direct impact on the growth of our firm.

Responsibilities:

  • Outreach and Engagement: Implement deal specific outreach strategies (cold calling and email campaigns) to gauge interest in active opportunities, and nurture them toward further discussions.
  • Appointment Setting: Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified capital providers and our senior team, ensuring a smooth handoff for follow-up discussions.
  • Phone-Based Research: Conduct introductory calls with lenders and investors to capture high-level criteria, including preferred loan types, deal sizes, and geographic focus.
  • Web-Based Research: Review lender websites, industry databases, and online resources to identify, update, and validate current lending programs and parameters.
  • Database Research: Review and update existing capital provider investment parameters in our CRM, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with senior team members to align outreach efforts with active deals and capital-raising initiatives.
  • Reporting: Prepare and share weekly progress updates on outreach activities, database updates, and key findings from conversations.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay current on industry trends, lender activity, market conditions, and competitor movements within the U.S. commercial real estate sector; provide valuable insights to the team.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years in research, business development, sales support, or a related role.
  • Preferred: Experience in real estate, finance, or capital brokerage, particularly within the U.S. commercial real estate market.
  • Fluent in English (C1 or higher), with strong verbal communication skills and confidence in making professional outreach calls.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of outreach calls each week.
  • Skilled in gathering, synthesizing, and presenting information from databases, websites, and direct conversations.
  • Skilled at leveraging online research tools (including websites, LinkedIn, and industry databases) to source and evaluate capital providers.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple outreach activities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and CRM systems (HubSpot preferred).
  • Tech-savvy with experience using cold-emailing and calling tools (e.g., Instantly) and best practices.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

Our Company:

We are a dynamic, growing entrepreneurial company established in 2020, specializing in capital brokerage services to help real estate owners and developers raise debt and equity capital. Our focus is primarily on multifamily and hospitality properties, although we have successfully financed a wide range of property types. We thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and seek passionate, driven individuals who want to be a part of our exciting journey.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation structure.
  • Opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and collaborative team environment.
  • Fully remote work.
  • Growth and professional development opportunities within a fast-growing company.

If you're a results-driven individual with a passion for real estate, we encourage you to apply and join our team!

title: Growth Account Executive (US market | SaaS | B2B)
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!

At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we expand into the US market, we're on the lookout for adventurous, diverse, and passionate Brazilian talents to join us on this exciting journey. Become a part of our team and take your career to new heights with SleekFlow!

Associate Level

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Business-level fluency in English

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the US market expansion, develop client relationships, and driving US sales growth
  • Actively manage the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing warm leads generated by marketing and sales development
  • Full sales cycle rep, actively managing the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing
  • Managing complex sales cycles and presenting to C-level executives the value of SleekFlow's software
  • A Hunter mindset - the role would require you to be resourceful when coming up with your territory plan, sourcing for leads & opportunities and being able to generate enough curiosity to land the crucial first meetings with the target Accounts.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while creating satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Demonstrating our product via video conferencing
  • Stay abreast of the latest trends in internet technology and eCommerce

Qualifications

  • Business-level fluency in English is a must (American accent preferred) & Portuguese, Spanish will be a plus
  • Degree in Business or a related field (preferred with USA background)
  • Experience carrying a quota and closing deals in software (business applications preferred) or technology sales
  • Consistently over-achieved quota (top 5-10% of the company) in past positions
  • High level of initiative and self-motivation. Attention to detail and strong communication skills
  • Proven ability to work well within a team environment while accomplishing individual tasks
  • High level of curiosity and empathy with the ability to understand a potential customer's context, issues and pain points through effective questioning and listening
  • Excellent attention to detail with a good understanding of the sales cycle and the importance of accurate pipelining and forecast reporting
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Strong customer references
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Procuramos Cientista de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

Competências Técnicas:

Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.

Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).

Diferenciais:

Experiência com dados de IoT, especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.

Formação:

Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa nas áreas mencionadas.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos PMP e experiência na indústria financeira, além de ter atuado em entregas de projetos globais de grande escala;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura, pois fará uso constante do idioma, participando de reuniões e apresentações em inglês;

Atividades:

  • Apoiar a integração de soluções tecnológicas que ampliem a oferta de produtos do cliente;
  • Desenvolver planos e garantir o progresso na reestruturação de aplicações para os padrões tecnológicos do cliente;
  • Gerenciar aspectos de iniciativas complexas e de grande escala, incluindo planejamento, execução, cronograma, qualidade, satisfação do cliente e identificação precoce de possíveis problemas;

  • CLT pela BRQ, salário a combinar+ benefícios

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.

You'll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.

This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.

We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.

Who are we?

BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in China.

What you will do:

  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.

What we expect from you:

  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.

What We Offer

  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We're building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who'll make it happen.

title: UI / UX Engineer

You will play a pivotal front-end engineering role in a platform involving designing, implementing and delivering a foundational platform for AI and Automation, leveraging Microsoft Azure as the primary technology stack.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia. This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development: Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration: Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership: Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation: Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery: Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent

title: Especialista de Logística
description:

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Integração com Outras Áreas

title: Operador(a) Painel Caldeira de Força e ETAC
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Operar e monitorar o Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído (SDCD) das áreas da Caldeira de Força (geração de vapor de alta pressão), da Estação de Tratamento de Água de Caldeira (ETAC) e sistema de óleo combustível, garantindo o funcionamento seguro, eficiente e contínuo dos equipamentos e processos, seguindo procedimentos, identificando e reportando anomalias, e atuando proativamente para manter a estabilidade da geração de vapor e a qualidade da água de alimentação da caldeira, contribuindo para a confiabilidade e disponibilidade energética da fábrica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar o SDCD para controle dos equipamentos da Caldeira de Força e da ETAC, garantindo o funcionamento seguro e eficiente dos sistemas;
  • Acompanhar parâmetros de processo (pressão, temperatura, vazão, qualidade da água, etc.), realizando ajustes para manter as condições ideais de operação;
  • Executar partidas e paradas de equipamentos, conforme procedimentos operacionais e padrões de segurança;
  • Monitorar e ajustar os parâmetros químicos da água da caldeira e do sistema de tratamento (pH, condutividade, sílica, fosfato), assegurando a integridade dos equipamentos;
  • Identificar e tratar alarmes e anomalias operacionais, comunicando ocorrências e acionando as áreas envolvidas;
  • Registrar dados operacionais e acompanhar o desempenho dos equipamentos após manutenções;
  • Manter comunicação constante com operadores de campo e laboratório, garantindo a estabilidade e qualidade do processo;
  • Cumprir e promover as normas de segurança, meio ambiente, qualidade e compliance;
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos e de segurança, zelando pelo bom funcionamento do painel SDCD e equipamentos.

Requisitos para a função:

  • Curso técnico completo em Papel e Celulose, Química, Eletrotécnica, Automação Industrial e/ou afins;
  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;
  • Conhecimento dos princípios de geração de vapor em caldeiras de força;
  • Conhecimento dos processos de tratamento de água industrial;
  • Experiência com Operação de sistemas de controle e automação industrial, especialmente SDCD (Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído);
  • Conhecimento em instrumentação industrial (sensores de pressão, temperatura, vazão, nível, pH, condutividade, analisadores de gases, etc.) relevantes para as áreas;
  • Conhecimento em química do tratamento de água de caldeiras;
  • Experiência com análise de dados de processo para identificação de tendências e desvios nas áreas;
  • Vivência em Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento com Ferramentas de Qualidade;
  • Conhecimento no pacote Office, SAP e Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Inglês e Espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you're responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You're motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer's secure environment, so you're prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You'll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • As a Regional Sales Manager(Federal DoD and/or Civilian), you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer

  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors

  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments

  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks

  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory

  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.

  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services

  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context

  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers

  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts

  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)

  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions

  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals

Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You're an amazing sales person – you're just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Palo Alto Networks is evolving and changing the nature of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we've rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.

Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.

Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company's expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.
