title: Director of Government Affairs
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

About the Role:

We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Government Affairs Director with expertise in regulatory issues, particularly relating to the Administrative Council for Economic Defense (CADE) in Brazil. This role is crucial for navigating the complex landscape of government regulations and ensuring compliance and strategic alignment with our organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement strategies for government relations, focusing on regulatory compliance and advocacy related to CADE and other relevant authorities.
  • Monitor and analyze legislative and regulatory developments that impact the organization, providing timely insights and recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the organization and governmental bodies, including CADE, fostering strong relationships and communication channels.
  • Advise senior management and internal teams on regulatory requirements, ensuring that business operations adhere to legal standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align regulatory strategies with business objectives, facilitating seamless integration of compliance into operational processes.
  • Represent the organization in meetings, hearings, and negotiations with government officials and regulatory agencies.
  • Prepare detailed reports, presentations, and documentation to support regulatory initiatives and inform stakeholders of progress and outcomes.
  • Identify potential regulatory risks and develop mitigation strategies to safeguard the organization's interests.
  • Robust experience in regulatory affairs, competition law, or government relations, with a strong track record of working with CADE and federal agencies.
  • Expertise in antitrust law, regulatory compliance, and policy advocacy in tech, fintech, or related industries (experience in digital platforms is a plus).
  • Proven ability to navigate complex regulatory landscapes and drive favorable outcomes in high-pressure scenarios.
  • Exceptional negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence C-suite executives and government officials.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Public Policy, or related field.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Se você tá cansado de empresa que promete e não entrega, vem pra São Prático.

  • Pós-Venda e NPS: implantar processos de pesquisa de satisfação e cuidar da jornada do cliente após a compra.
  • Gestão de Influenciadores: ampliar e organizar o relacionamento com criadores de conteúdo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em e-commerce e performance digital.
  • Conhecimento avançado em métricas de vendas online e ferramentas como GA4, Meta Ads, Google Sheets, Shopify Analytics.
  • Perfil extremamente analítico, com foco em resultado e entrega de metas.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de planejamento, execução e resolução de problemas com autonomia.
  • Alta energia, proatividade e senso de urgência.
  • Excelência em organização e comunicação.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas que contarão pontos):

  • Experiência prévia com Shopify.
  • Vivência com funil de vendas e CRM.
  • Conhecimento em ERP (ex: Bling).
  • Experiência em implantação de projetos de crescimento ou reestruturação de e-commerce.

O que esperamos de você:

Alguém que vista a camisa, que goste de desafios, que saiba resolver problemas, organizar o time e olhar para os números com atenção diária. Alguém que queira crescer junto com uma marca que está pronta para dar o próximo grande passo.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

description:
Na PepsiCo estamos comprometidos em atrair os melhores talentos, pessoas movidas a desafios e inspiradas por oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional. O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o "porquê" por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);
  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas de Big Data (Spark, Databricks);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Conhecimento em MLOps (deploy de modelos, Docker, CI/CD);
  • Experiência em Deep Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch);
  • Participação em projetos de Sistemas de Recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, embeddings, modelos híbridos);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, ChromaDB) e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

title: Account Manager, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry's most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry's broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts.   • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network's Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting

Qualifications

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You're an amazing salesperson – you're just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We're problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  • Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  • Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  • Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  • Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.

Job Requirements

  • Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  • Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  • A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  • A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  • Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  • Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Government Affairs Senior Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Government Relations Manager to oversee our interactions with state and municipal governments and manage relationships with industry associations. This role is critical for building and maintaining effective partnerships that support our organizational objectives and enhance our public policy initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with state and municipal government officials to advance organizational goals and policy priorities.
  • Monitor regional legislative and policy developments, analyzing their potential impact on our operations and providing strategic recommendations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with key industry associations, fostering collaborative partnerships and advocating for shared interests.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align government relations strategies with business objectives, ensuring cohesive integration and compliance.
  • Represent the organization at governmental meetings, public hearings, and industry association events, advocating for organizational positions and strengthening partnerships.
  • Prepare briefings, reports, and presentations for senior management, highlighting opportunities and challenges in state and municipal affairs.
  • Identify and mitigate potential government-related risks, developing strategies to address them proactively.

Requirements:

  • Relevant experience in government relations or a related field, with a focus on state and municipal affairs and association engagement.
  • Proven ability to build and manage relationships with government officials and industry associations effectively.
  • Strong understanding of regional political landscapes and public policy processes.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of articulating organizational positions clearly and persuasively.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully managing and advocating for public policy initiatives at the state and municipal levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Political Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

A Zubale é uma empresa de tecnologia que ajuda os varejistas a vencer no e-commerce.

Com mais de US$ 70 milhões em capital de risco, crescemos de forma consistente nos últimos seis anos e já completamos mais de 150 milhões de pedidos através da nossa plataforma.

Hoje, atendemos mais de 100 clientes e contamos com milhares de freelancers em nossa rede.

Você é um profissional de vendas orientado a resultados, com mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada superando metas de forma consistente. Possui um perfil analítico, com forte disciplina na medição e acompanhamento de indicadores para embasar decisões estratégicas.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Ser responsável pela investigação de eventos, em máquinas, equipamentos, dispositivos e/ou sistemas, onde tenham ocorridos danos e/ou falhas e fornecer um estudo de causa identificando o mecanismos ocasionador da falha, a extensão dos danos diretos e indiretos, a identificação e segregação dos danos/desgastes pré-existentes e/ou não relacionados, bem como recomendações técnicas a respeito dos reparos necessários e, sempre que possível, a apuração dos custos envolvidos. Também responsável por decidir o curso de ação mais adequado em investigações e realizar revisões de relatórios para processos que assim forem atribuídos e/ou demandados pela Diretoria.

FUNÇÕES ESSENCIAIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atribuir processos a engenheiros de acordo com sua área de responsabilidade e gerenciar o controle de qualidade e prazos de atendimento a regulação e Seguradoras.
  • Avaliar eventos nos mais diversos cenários, desde os residenciais, rurais até os industriais e fabris de grande porte.
  • Conduzir investigações para determinar e documentar o mecanismo de falha apresentando quando necessário como o dano surgiu e se propagou até a ocorrência da falha, a extensão dos danos e o escopo dos reparos necessários.
  • Investigar, avaliar e determinar a causa raiz da falha respaldando a regulação de toda a base técnica necessária para avaliar a cobertura dos eventos nas apólices e justificar perante as seguradoras e resseguradores. Sugerir mitigações para reduzir as perdas.
  • Desenvolver planos, relatórios e apresentações para atender as necessidades dos clientes e determinar e documentar o método de análise de falhas e investigação das causas.
  • Analisar os danos constatados, separando do escopo aqueles que não possuem vínculo direto com o evento ou que são devidos a outros eventos ou apenas ao desgaste natural pelo uso.
  • Colaborar com outros investigadores das demais áreas de conhecimento, quando o evento não afeta uma única disciplina e/ou equipamento. Inclusive em investigações de incêndio, alagamentos, desabamentos e outras catástrofes.
  • Atuar como testemunha especialista em tribunal e/ou em depoimentos.
  • Discutir com equipes técnicas de fabricantes, segurados e outros especialistas na validação e comprovação dos estudos e análises sempre que pertinente.
  • Documentar e manter horas faturáveis com base em tempo dispendido nas investigações e estudos inerentes ao processo a ser investigado.
  • Colaborar com a equipe comercial, gerentes operacionais, arquitetos, advogados, reguladores, gerentes de sinistros, diretoria e outros parceiros visando desenvolver o mercado e novas demandas pelos serviços da EFI Global do Brasil.
  • Colaborar com o restante da equipe de peritos da EFI para alavancar experiências e auxiliar em projetos.

FUNÇÕES ADICIONAIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Executar outras tarefas conforme designado.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Apoiar os programas de qualidade da organização.
  • Fazer uso das boas práticas de engenharia e das normas técnicas que forem aprlicáveis aos processos.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Desejável ter carteira de habilitação - B
  • Bacharelado de uma faculdade ou universidade credenciada pelo MEC.
  • Registro / Licença de Engenheiro Profissional (PE) pelo CREA, no mínimo, 4 anos.

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Experiência mínima de 4 (quatro) anos, em indústria e/ou instalação de grande porte, realizando estudos de causa e análise de falhas, e gerenciamento de risco.

HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS

  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita
  • Conhecimento em informática, incluindo produtos do Microsoft Office
  • Habilidades analíticas e interpretativas
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente ou em um ambiente de equipe
  • Capacidade de atender ou exceder as Competências de Desempenho

title: Project Manager Sênior
description:
Project Manager Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por conduzir a execução de projetos estratégicos, garantindo que cada etapa — do planejamento ao deploy — aconteça dentro dos prazos, orçamentos e expectativas estabelecidas. Seu papel envolve coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, monitorar riscos, assegurar uma comunicação eficaz entre todas as partes envolvidas e garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Acompanhar o progresso de cada fase do projeto (refinamento, planejamento, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação, deploy e operação assistida), garantindo que as entregas ocorram dentro do cronograma e com qualidade;
  • Monitorar e reportar o andamento das atividades, promovendo visibilidade e alinhamento constante com stakeholders;
  • Validar o planejamento de sprints e prioridades, garantindo aderência aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Gerir recursos humanos e financeiros, assegurando a eficiência na alocação e uso dos investimentos;
  • Produzir materiais e relatórios de status para comitês executivos e áreas envolvidas;

title: Solutions Architect (OpenShift/Podman)
description:
Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we help people be their best in the moments that matter. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. Our work is very meaningful, impactful, and cutting edge and we invite you to explore it. We are the Best!

Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.

Join to the team providing Solution Architecture for Unified Communications customers for EMEA/APAC/LATAM regions.

Job Description

Join a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of mission-critical communications. We are responsible for delivering advanced Push-to-Talk (PTT) solutions over broadband with seamless interoperability to Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems. As a Network and Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining the core infrastructure that powers our services.

The ideal candidate is a skilled and proactive individual with a strong background in IP networking, a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, and an interest in cybersecurity. In addition to core engineering duties, you will take ownership of hardware ordering and security vulnerability management, making this a pivotal role within the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain robust IP network infrastructure, including switches and firewalls.
  • Manage and support virtualization and containerized environments, with a focus on cloud-native platforms like OpenShift and Podman.
  • Lead the hardware ordering process for the team, utilizing the Motorola CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) system.
  • Monitor and manage security-related issues, including vulnerability management for customer-facing solutions.
  • Ensure the reliable and secure interoperability between broadband PTT solutions and Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and contribute to solution architecture.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering
  • In-depth knowledge of IP networking principles and practical experience with switches and firewalls.
  • Demonstrated experience with virtualization technologies and container platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, such as OpenShift or Podman.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system maintenance and security.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications (A Plus)

Certifications:

  • CompTIA Network+, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Security+
  • CCNA or CCNP
  • Juniper, FortiGate, or Extreme Networks certifications

Engineering Expertise:

  • Experience with datacenter engineering, including server connectivity (Ethernet vs. fiber) and adapters.
  • A strong interest or background in cybersecurity.

Relevant Experience:

  • Previous experience with Push-to-Talk (PTT) over broadband or Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware ordering processes and CPQ systems.

title: Product Owner
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have:

A regional product owner is responsible for managing and aligning product development and strategy to endure product meets the needs of the local market while aligning with the broader product vision.

- Own the regional product backlog, prioritize features, and ensure that local requirements are incorporated into user stories working closely with regional product manager

- Work closely with local product owners, development team, marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure that regional needs are considered in the overall product development

- Work with legal and regulatory teams to ensure the product complies with regional laws, regulations and standards

- Ensure product is localized for the region, including language, cultural preferences and any necessary adjustments to functionality

- Maintain fit-gap analysis to understand custom vs regional development variance

- Represent the voice of the local country needs by ensuring the product meets local customer needs and build regional product solution

- Define epics, features and user stories to cover local business needs while incorporating UX

- Break down high level requirements into actionable user stories, ensure they are clear, concise and ready for the development team by clearly defining acceptance criteria

- PO will be responsible to make sure backlog is visible and understood by all stakeholders, including developers and regional product team

- Work with stakeholders and users to facilitate UAT and ensure the product works as expected

Test and validate that the product meets the defined acceptance criteria and business requirements

Collaborate with development team using agile execution model to ensure that features are developed and delivered on time

- Involve regional users in product testing, gather-feedback and iterate on product features to better fit local needs

- PO will act as a liaison between the stakeholders, regional and local teams ensuring the product aligns with the business vision and delivers customer value

- Actively participate in regional and local iteration and PI planning, daily standups and relevant agile ceremonies

- Fluency in English and Spanish required; Portuguese or French beneficial.

Core Skills

1. Product Management: Understanding of product lifecycle, product strategy, and roadmap development.

2. Agile Methodologies: Proficiency in Agile frameworks like Scrum and Kanban.

3. Backlog Management: Ability to create, prioritize, and manage a product backlog.

4. User Story Writing: Skill in writing clear and concise user stories and acceptance criteria.

5. Stakeholder Management: Effective communication and collaboration with stakeholders.

6. Market Research: Ability to conduct market research and competitive analysis.

7. Data Analysis: Proficiency in using data to inform product decisions.

8. Technical Understanding: Basic understanding of software development and technical concepts.

9. Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

10. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Tools and Technologies

1. Project Management Tools: Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.

2. Prototyping Tools: Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar tools.

3. Analytics Tools: Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or similar tools.

4. Collaboration Tools: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Confluence, or similar tools.

5. Version Control: Basic understanding of Git and GitHub.

Certifications (Optional but Beneficial)

1. Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)

2. Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO)

3. Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)

4. Certified Agile Product Manager and Product Owner (ICP-APO)

Soft Skills

1. Leadership: Ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams.

2. Empathy: Understanding and empathizing with user needs and pain points.

3. Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and environments.

4. Decision-Making: Ability to make informed decisions quickly.

5. Negotiation: Skill in negotiating with stakeholders and team members.

Domain Knowledge (Industry-Specific)

1. E-commerce: Understanding of online retail and customer behavior.

2. Fintech: Knowledge of financial/Insurance services and regulations.

3. Healthcare: Familiarity with healthcare systems and compliance.

4. SaaS: Experience with Software as a Service products and business models.

These skills and areas of expertise will help a Product Owner effectively manage and deliver successful products.

Advanced English or Spanish

Recruiters should look for candidates with strong agile experience, exposure to building regional product and implementation or strong product development experience overall.

Knowledge of C#/.NET programming language (back office)

Knowledge of cloud concepts, microservices, and APIs

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python) and integrating them into Esri's ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)
  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards
  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.
  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation.
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and ArcGIS Workflow Manager.
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python.
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems.
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.

What You'll Achieve

You'll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

● Desenvolver aplicações e serviços backend em Java (usando Spring Boot) focados no processamento e integração de dados, incluindo a construção de APIs RESTful ou microserviços que permitam o consumo e fornecimento de dados via base dimensional.

● Implementar pipelines de dados e fluxos de processamento em Java, integrando com sistemas de mensageria (ex: Apache Kafka) e outros mecanismos de streaming quando necessário, para capturar dados transacionais em tempo real e persistí-los de forma segura.

● Projetar e otimizar esquemas de banco de dados PostgreSQL para armazenar dados = provenientes de sistemas legados ou da camada de ingestão, garantindo normalização adequada ou modelagem relacional conforme necessário, além de criar índices e otimizar consultas para alto desempenho.

● Colaborar com o time de arquitetura e outros engenheiros de dados para assegurar que as soluções desenvolvidas em Java/PostgreSQL estejam alinhadas com a arquitetura dimensional e não gerem redundâncias ou inconsistências com as demais fontes de dados.

● Implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e monitoramento nos serviços desenvolvidos, assegurando que falhas sejam rapidamente identificadas (logs, métricas, telemetria) e colaborando com a equipe de SRE para implantar monitoramento e alertas adequados.

● Participar da integração de dados entre o PostgreSQL e outras camadas da plataforma (por exemplo, exportando dados para Data Lake ou fornecendo dados atualizados para aplicações de relatório), escrevendo scripts ou procedimentos armazenados quando necessário.

● Dar suporte e manutenção evolutiva aos componentes desenvolvidos, tanto durante a fase de construção quanto na sustentação posterior, incluindo documentação clara do código e das integrações realizadas.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Experiência em construção de APIs REST e microserviços, com práticas de versionamento, segurança (autenticação/autorização) e documentação (OpenAPI/Swagger).

● Familiaridade com sistemas de mensageria e event streaming (Kafka ou similares) e integração de aplicações Java com esses sistemas (producers/consumers, processamento de eventos).

● Conhecimento de ferramentas de build e entrega contínua para Java (Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/GitLab CI) e experiência básica em containerização (Docker) para deploy dos serviços.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro.

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica
